sentences.text: [solemn] This volcano killed twenty-eight thousand people, and missed one guy in jail.
In nineteen oh two, Ludger was locked in a stone cell for a bar fight.
[lowering their voice] A cloud of burning gas flattened the town in minutes.
Days later, rescuers heard him shouting.
[after a long pause] Then he joined the circus, as the man who survived doomsday.
Next: dropped into ancient Rome with a dying phone.
